summary: Document Agent Teams mining and rollout order
description: Capture the Agent Teams AI mining outcome as public-safe docs/ADR-style guidance and define the rollout order across capacity policy, review lifecycle, evidence gates, and usage attribution. No AGPL code copied.
acceptance: Docs name the mined patterns and provenance without copying AGPL source code.
Rollout order explains why capacity policy and review lifecycle come before broad multi-agent UI/workflow expansion.
Docs include operational guidance for default solo mode, reviewer lane use, and when worktree isolation is justified.
Validation confirms the .go hierarchy links all split tasks and keeps them open/unclaimed.
